title: Retained-run stack attachment
description: Manual public CLI/RPC proof on an ordinary retained standalone run with real pushed upstream work. Supply FARMSLOT_STACK_ATTACHMENT_PROOF_CONFIG and select attachment or attachment-after-restart after restarting the owned candidate gateway. Missing inputs refuse; no run or stack is seeded.

attachment.cmd: case "${FARMSLOT_STACK_ATTACHMENT_PROOF_STAGE:-attachment}" in attachment|attachment-after-restart) TSX_TSCONFIG_PATH=services/gateway/tsconfig.json node --import tsx scripts/runner-validation/gateway/stack-base-consumers.mts "${FARMSLOT_STACK_ATTACHMENT_PROOF_STAGE:-attachment}" ;; *) printf "%s\n" "Select attachment or attachment-after-restart" >&2; exit 2 ;; esac
attachment.intent: Retained work keeps its run identity, source, task and engine evidence when linked to the declared upstream, including after a gateway restart.
